summary: Iteration 7 fully verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (PIN lockout progression 4->3->2->1->locked/30s, correct PIN blocked while locked, change-pin clears lock, state never exposes pin/pin_hash, config.setup_done added + persisted + reset-restores-false, PWA assets manifest.json/icon-192/icon-512/apple-touch-icon all 200, manifest has maskable+standalone, index.html has manifest+apple-touch-startup-image links). Frontend: PinLock lockout UI works — red shake, subtitle 'Incorrect PIN · N attempts left' counts down 4->3->2->1, at 5th wrong subtitle becomes 'Too many attempts · retry in Ns' countdown, keypad dims to opacity 0.4 and pointer-events:none, buttons disabled, ShieldAlert icon shown. Setup wizard auto-opens on unlock when setup_done=false; welcome→matrix→amp→ecobee→camera→tv→done navigates; wizard-live-matrix toggle reveals wizard-matrix-host input; toggling wizard-live-tv reveals wizard-tv-ip-tv_living; wizard-finish PUTs config and setup_done becomes true and closes; wizard-skip closes without finishing; run-wizard-btn in Settings reopens it. Settings screensaver card and toggle present, localStorage 'c4_saver' updates on toggle, no console errors from ScreenSaver mount. All bottom-nav tabs navigable. State/PIN cleanup performed at end.
critical_code_review_comments: PinLock useEffect deps use `[retry > 0]` which is a boolean expression — React lint may warn (exhaustive-deps). Works but not idiomatic; prefer `[locked]` or `[retry]`.

SetupWizard: `cfg` state is initialized once from state?.config; if state loads after mount (SystemContext), the wizard may open with empty cfg. Auto-open flow works today because unlock happens after state fetch, but a guard/effect to sync cfg when state changes would be more robust.
ScreenSaver: 90s idle activation not exercised (long duration). Toggle + mount verified clean. Consider adding a debug shortcut or lower-timeout prop for tests.

Backend PIN escalation formula: retry_after doubles per failure past threshold (30, 60, 120, 240, 300 cap). Only the first lockout (30s) verified; escalation not asserted (would require waiting 30s+). Documented as expected.
seed_data_creation: None; state reset and PIN reset to 1234 with lock cleared as post-test cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 7 all green. Note the Settings drawer trigger testid is `open-settings-btn` (in TopBar.jsx), NOT `settings-btn`. Setup wizard auto-opens on every unlock when config.setup_done=false; POST /api/state/reset flips it back to false — call wizard-skip before testing other tabs. PIN change-pin endpoint acts as reliable lock-reset. All device dispatch is MOCKED in cloud.
